elements.description:
Today's answer and an earlier answer to the same question side by side, the difference highlighted, with dismiss
and open-the-earlier-session.

properties.name: earlier
properties.description: The earlier answer – on the left

properties.name: question
properties.description: The question both answers were given to, shown under the heading

properties.name: heading
properties.default: "This answer differs from an earlier one"

properties.name: summary
properties.description: A line from your product on what changed, e.g. "The notice period went from 30 to 60 days"

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: Shows both answers in full; unset, long answers show only the changes and the words around them

properties.name: context
properties.description: How many shared words to keep either side of a change while not expanded

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-expanded-change
events.description: "Show full answers" or "Show changes only" was pressed; detail `{ expanded }`: DisagreementExpandedChange. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-dismiss
events.description: Dismiss was pressed (with `dismissible`); detail `null`. Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the banner.

events.name: tc-open-session
events.description: "Open earlier session" was pressed (with `can-open`); detail `{ sessionId, answer }`: DisagreementOpenSession.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Shows both answers in full (controlled). Leave it undefined to let the banner keep it, starting at `defaultExpanded`

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether both answers show in full at first when uncontrolled

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when "Show full answers" or "Show changes only" is pressed, controlled or not

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows Dismiss and is called when it's pressed; return false to keep the banner

props.name: onOpenEarlier
props.description: Shows "Open earlier session" and is called with the earlier answer's session id when it's pressed

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.
